newEvidence.providerOfficial: Evolution confirms betting occurs only during the spin, but does not state that full ball+wheel tracking view remains visible before betting closes.
newEvidence.independentTimingReview: A current Speed Roulette sequence review reports betting opens at ~0 s, ball launch ~7-8 s, bets close ~15 s, ball lands ~22-24 s, and specifically reports that the full wheel/ball view is deliberately hidden until betting has ended to prevent wheel tracking.

scientificPrior.reference: Small & Tse, Chaos 22 (2012), Predicting the outcome of roulette
scientificPrior.finding: Physical roulette can be predictively exploitable if contemporaneous ball/wheel state is observable before wagers close.

closureLogic: Betting-during-spin alone is insufficient for a ballistic edge.
The required signal is contemporaneous full wheel+ball phase/velocity before betting closes.
Public evidence now suggests Evolution intentionally withholds that full view until after betting closes.
Therefore no operator-independent green can be claimed from Speed Roulette timing alone.
reopenOnlyIf: A zero-wager recording from the exact Botemania-served table shows usable full ball+wheel motion while the betting interface is still enabled.
A passive prospective dataset from that exact table demonstrates a frozen sector predictor whose lower confidence bound exceeds k/36 after latency.
